report.description: UUID of the report config that generated this run.

content.description: Generated report content (markdown or structured text).

metadata.description: Run metadata including model used, token counts, and generation stats.

period_start.description: Start of the evaluation window covered by this report.

period_end.description: End of the evaluation window covered by this report.

delivery_status.description:
'pending', 'delivered', or 'failed'.

* `pending` - Pending
* `delivered` - Delivered
* `partial_failure` - Partial Failure
* `failed` - Failed

delivery_errors.description: List of delivery error messages if delivery failed.
